examples.title: Everyday questions. Clear next steps.
examples.lead: You stay in charge. AssetFlow turns the details you already have into a practical plan you can review, confirm, and keep up to date.

item1.quote: “Where is the receipt, and what needs doing next?”
item1.help: Keep the document with the right asset, then see the next confirmed task without searching through drawers, inboxes, or memory.

item2.quote: “Did we already take care of this?”
item2.help: Record completed work as it happens, so everyone in the household can see what was done and when.

item3.quote: “I bought a used car. What should I check first?”
item3.help: Add the car, attach its service history, and review a smart maintenance plan before confirming the dates that matter to you.

item4.quote: “The washing machine is acting up. Can I find the warranty?”
item4.help: Link the receipt, warranty, and notes to the appliance so the evidence is ready when you need it.

item5.help: Build a plan for the boiler, heat pump, bike, or home system, then choose what to confirm and when.

item6.quote: “Where are the solar-panel documents, and when should we check them?”
item6.help: Keep the installation records and service notes with the home, then track the next review without relying on a folder or a reminder in your head.

flowAI.title: Meet Flow AI, your assistant for asset records
flowAI.lead: Flow AI understands the records and completed work you add to each asset. Ask questions, uncover useful insights, and turn findings into suggested actions, tasks, or a smart maintenance plan—all for you to review.
flowAI.step1Body: Get answers from the manuals, invoices, notes, and completed work you have saved with an asset.
flowAI.step2Body: Flow AI can bring relevant details and potential gaps in your records to your attention.
flowAI.step3Body: Use a finding to draft a task or build a smart maintenance plan, then review and adjust it before it becomes yours.
flowAI.question: What should I check before the next service?

flowAI.nextBody: Review the suggestion, adjust the details, and decide what to add.

preferredAI.title: Your preferred AI. Your assets, organized.
preferredAI.lead: Keep using your assistants and agents while My AssetsFlow keeps your asset information organized. Connect an assistant such as ChatGPT or Claude to the assets you choose.
preferredAI.controls: Approve the connection explicitly. Share selected assets and their related tasks with read-only access. Revoke access whenever you choose.
preferredAI.compatibility: Remote MCP tools connect your records to compatible assistants. Availability depends on the provider, account plan and workspace settings; each connection needs verification.
preferredAI.privacy: Information shared with an assistant is subject to that provider’s policies. Revoking access stops future reads; it does not erase information already shared.

aiPage.lead: Work with Flow AI inside My AssetsFlow, or bring your organized asset information to a compatible assistant. Understand your records, investigate what matters and prepare your next step.
aiPage.securityTitle: Your assets. Your permissions. Your call.
aiPage.securityLead: You decide what is shared, which connection to approve and which proposed actions to accept.
aiPage.approvalBody: Review the assistant’s identity and requested access before you authorize a connection. Revoke access from your connection settings.
aiPage.selectionBody: Choose the assets that connected assistants can read. Sharing includes related tasks and applies to all your connected assistants, including assets you enable later.
aiPage.readBody: External assistants read approved structured asset details and tasks. The connector does not change records, import files or carry out maintenance. Imports and writes are planned.
aiPage.privacyBody: Documents, private notes and location are outside the connector. Asset names and task text may still contain personal information. Shared information follows the assistant provider’s policies; revocation does not erase past disclosures.
aiPage.agentLead: Move from a question to a useful next step. Flow AI brings context and proposed actions together, while you keep control of what becomes part of your records.
aiPage.step1Body: Ask about the information you have saved. Flow AI finds relevant records and highlights details or gaps worth checking.
aiPage.step2Body: Use the findings to prepare suggested actions, tasks or a smart maintenance plan. Review the evidence and adjust the proposal.
aiPage.step3Body: Choose what to confirm. Keep suggestions separate from recorded facts and completed work. External assistants keep read-only access through the connector.
aiPage.note: AI works from the available records. Check its answers and proposed actions; it does not replace an inspection or professional advice.

trust.title: Your assets. Your control.
trust.lead: Choose who sees your assets, review what AI proposes, and manage your information from your account.
trust.sharingBody: Decide which assets household members can access. Private assets stay outside their shared view.
trust.contextBody: Private document retrieval and public web research run separately. Web research uses a redacted question.
trust.reviewBody: AI suggestions are drafts. Check their references, adjust the details and confirm the changes you want.
trust.connectorBody: Connect explicitly, share selected assets with read-only access and revoke future access at any time. Revocation does not erase information already shared.
trust.rightsBody: Manage data export and account deletion in Settings. Information shared with an external assistant follows that provider’s policies.
trust.actBody: The EU AI Act sets transparency duties for AI interactions. Flow AI is identified as AI and presents suggestions for your review.
